capture_use: Set pose, let it settle, then capture a static pose. No realtime motion capture requirement.
production_baseline: Preserve O5 AS5048 A, G0 external, 41 measured + 3 fixed slots; no new physical hardware accepted.
motion_acceptance: Do not remove motions or presume a back pod clears reaching/lying/bending. Check both characters and arms, actual links, electronics and harness.
supplier_policy: Keep current parts unless a specific digital/mechanical/electrical blocker or supported improvement warrants change. Local supplier is a candidate criterion, not proof of superiority.

trial_adoptions.M4_spring: Raleigh A 8 x 4.2 x 0.4, 210 N catalog point; guide redesigned, no drop-in claim, no physical qualification

gates.single_joint_nominal: Only scoped geometry checks pass; force, precision, bond and production fits remain open
